nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, let $\tau_k$ be the substitution on letters in $\mathbb{N}$ sending $k$ to the two-letter word $k\,1$ and every other letter $i$ to the one-letter word $i + 1$. For every finite word $w$ over $\mathbb{N}$, the word $\tau_k(w)$, obtained by replacing each letter of $w$ by its image under $\tau_k$, is at least as long as $w$: $|w| \le |\tau_k(w)|$.
nodes.title: The generalized Hofstadter substitution does not shorten words

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, let $\tau_k$ be the substitution on letters in $\mathbb{N}$ sending $k$ to the two-letter word $k\,1$ and every other letter $m$ to the one-letter word $m + 1$. For every natural number $i$, the image $\tau_k(i)$ of the letter $i$ has length at least $1$.
nodes.title: Letter images under the generalized Hofstadter substitution are nonempty

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $j$, let $\tau_k$ be the substitution on letters in $\mathbb{N}$ sending $k$ to the two-letter word $k\,1$ and every other letter $i$ to the one-letter word $i + 1$, extended letter by letter to finite words. The word $\tau_k^j(k)$, obtained by applying $\tau_k$ $j$ times to the one-letter word $k$, has length at least $j + 1$.
nodes.title: Growth of the iterated generalized Hofstadter substitution

can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
